decisions.reason: As a glazed variant within the firm's core industrial sectional door platform, it costs little to keep, and its continued presence through 2019 gives no sign that its value has failed to materialize, unlike the dropped garage products.
The insulated glazed industrial door fits growing demand for thermal efficiency and shares production with existing lines, so keeping this option open is cheap and its upside remains plausible.
Its dedicated product page in both observed years signals a committed, established offering in the firm's core industrial segment, with low carrying cost and no evidence of failure.
